labels: enhancement

---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of what the problem is, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]".

## Describe the solution you'd like

What you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, links to similar features elsewhere, how big a change you think this is.

Note: for anything larger than a small fix, it helps to open the issue before starting work so we
can talk through the approach together.
